                    "[44] unspam",

                    "[48] cfreeze [plr] -- Freezes a player on your client, they will only be frozen for you",

                    prefix = prefix
                    speedfly = speedfly

                function GetPlayer(n)
                    local o = {}
                    local p = n:lower()
                    if p == "all" then
                        for q, r in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                            table.insert(o, r)
                        end
                    elseif p == "others" then
                        for q, r in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                            if r.Name ~= lplayer.Name then
                                table.insert(o, r)
                            end
                        end
                    elseif p == "me" then
                        for q, r in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                            if r.Name == lplayer.Name then
